subject: English 1st Paper

source.edition: Revised for the year 2026; revised edition October 2025

passagePolicy: Use the specifically cited source section in the NCTB textbook. Full textbook passages and images are not reproduced. Original writing models are not source facts.

activities.instruction: Answer using the cited text. Equivalent accurate wording is acceptable; support interpretations with details.

items.question: Who are Hena and Bina?
items.modelAnswer: They are twin sisters in class six.

items.question: Which test are they taking in the scene?
items.modelAnswer: They are taking an English test during the half-yearly examination.

items.question: Why should pupils read the questions carefully?
items.modelAnswer: Careful reading helps them understand the instructions and answer the actual questions.

items.question: Write a suitable instruction against copying another pupil’s script.
items.modelAnswer: Do not copy from someone else’s script.

items.question: What should people do with litter according to the sign task?
items.modelAnswer: They should use the waste bin rather than throw litter in public places.

activities.instruction: Explain the word in the cited context, or give the requested alternative meaning. Accept suitable equivalent wording.

acceptedAnswers: a pupil’s written exam answer paper in this context
small pieces of rubbish left in an unsuitable place

limitations: Initial Draft pool, not exhaustive chapter quotas or a complete model paper.
Teacher review, Drive backup and website registration are separate steps.
The story’s one-hour restriction is not a rule for all exams. Accessibility needs and real examination arrangements must be handled by responsible staff.
The textbook’s signs are read as source examples, not a full road-safety course.
